sutta: Buddha he went to hell for a long time 5.4 kumaraka that's how I heard at one time the Lord was staying near savati in the Jeter wood and anata pindika's Monastery on that occasion the number of boys in between sabati and the jeterwood were tormenting the fish in the pool then the Lord having put on his robe in the fall noon and taken his bowl and outer cloak was going to sabati to collect arms food when he saw those boys in between savati and the jeterwood tormenting the fish on seeing this he went up to them and said do you boys feel pain do you dislike pain and they said yes we do fear pain we dislike pain they're not realizing its significance the Lord acted on that occasion this inspired utterance if you feel pain if you dislike pain do not do a bad deed openly or in secret if you have done a bad deed or do one now you will not Escape pain though you try to flee
